name: 出厂检测原始数据
content:
SELECT d.incomingMaterialQcItemDetails2Id recordKey,
                h.incomingMaterialQcFormId AS `单据标识`,h.c_incomingQcNo AS `质检单号`,d.c_timePoint AS `检测时间`,
                d.c_luyanshu AS `炉眼`,d.c_faqiliang AS `发气量_L每kg`,
                d.c_linhuaqing AS `磷化氢_百分比`,d.c_liuhuaqing AS `硫化氢_百分比`,d.c_jieguo AS `原检验结果`
                FROM t_incomingmaterialqcitemdetails2 d JOIN t_incomingmaterialqcform h
                ON h.incomingMaterialQcFormId=d.mdIncomingMaterialQcFormId AND h.isDeleted=0
                WHERE (:formNumber='' OR h.c_incomingQcNo=:formNumber) AND d.isDeleted=0 AND h.c_qualityInspection=:category ORDER BY d.incomingMaterialQcItemDetails2Id

inputs.name: category
inputs.label: 质检类别（1来料、2过程、3成品）
